ayahs.1: By Mount Tur—Allah swears by the sacred mountain where Moses received revelation.
ayahs.3: on open pages for all to read—
ayahs.5: and by the canopy raised high,
ayahs.6: and by the sea set ablaze—
ayahs.7: your Rabb's punishment will certainly come to pass.
ayahs.9: On the Day the heavens will shake violently,
ayahs.10: and the mountains will be blown away entirely.
ayahs.11: Woe on that Day to the deniers—
ayahs.12: those who amused themselves with falsehood.
ayahs.13: The Day they will be shoved forcefully into the Fire of Hell.
ayahs.14: This is the Fire you used to deny.
ayahs.15: Is this magic, or do you not see?
ayahs.16: Burn in it. Whether you endure patiently or not, it is the same—you are rewarded only for what you used to do.
ayahs.17: The righteous will be in Gardens and bliss,
ayahs.18: enjoying what their Rabb has given them. Their Rabb protected them from the torment of the blazing Fire.
ayahs.19: Eat and drink happily for what you used to do.
ayahs.20: They will recline on thrones, lined up facing one another. We will pair them with companions of beautiful eyes.
ayahs.21: As for those who believed and whose children followed them in iman, We will join their children to them without diminishing any of their reward. Every person is accountable only for what they themselves did.
ayahs.22: We will continually provide them with whatever fruit or meat they desire.
ayahs.23: They will pass to one another a cup of wine that leads to no idle talk and no sin.
ayahs.24: Youthful servants will wait on them like hidden pearls.
ayahs.25: They will turn to one another, asking questions.
ayahs.26: They will say: Before this we used to stand in awe of Allah among our people.
ayahs.27: So Allah favoured us and protected us from the scorching heat of Hell.
ayahs.28: We used to call on Him before. He is truly the Most Kind, the Rahim.
ayahs.29: So keep reminding. By your Rabb's grace you are not a fortune-teller or a madman.
ayahs.30: Or do they say: He is a poet, and we are waiting for time to undo him?
ayahs.31: Say: Keep waiting—I too am among those who wait.
ayahs.32: Or do their minds command them to this? Or are they simply a people who transgress?
ayahs.33: Or do they say: He invented it? In fact, they have no iman.
ayahs.34: Let them produce a recitation like it, if they are truthful.
ayahs.35: Were they created from nothing, or are they their own creators?
ayahs.36: Or did they create the heavens and the earth? In fact, they have no firm conviction.
ayahs.37: Or do they possess the treasuries of your Rabb? Or are they in control?
ayahs.38: Or do they have a stairway by which they eavesdrop on the heavens? Then let whoever does so bring clear proof.
ayahs.39: Or does He have daughters while you prefer sons?
ayahs.40: Or are you asking them for payment, so they are burdened with debt?
ayahs.41: Or do they possess the unseen and write it down?
ayahs.42: Or do they intend to plot? Then it is those who reject the truth who will be outplotted.
ayahs.43: Or do they have a god besides Allah? Glorified is Allah far above what they associate with Him.
ayahs.44: If they were to see a piece of the sky falling, they would still say: It is only piled-up clouds.
ayahs.45: So leave them until they meet their Day when they will be struck down—
ayahs.46: the Day their scheming will not benefit them at all, and they will not be helped.
ayahs.47: The wrongdoers will have another torment before that Day, but most of them do not know.
ayahs.48: So endure with sabr your Rabb's decree. You are under Our watchful care. Glorify your Rabb when you rise,
ayahs.49: and glorify Him during part of the night and at the fading of the stars.
